[...] The mission of the international track of our master of science in computer science is to prepare and train the next generation of decision and data scientists. M.s. international-track students will familiarize themselves with a broad range of theoretical and computational techniques from many areas of the mathematical and computational sciences. [...] The students will develop an expertise in cutting-edge techniques for decision and data sciences through courses taught by distinguished researchers and significant involvement in research activities. Upon receiving the M.S. degree, these students will be competent not only in designing effective and innovative methodologies for decision making and data management, but also in identifying and implementing the most pertinent software.

## Master of Science In Computer Science

The mission of the international track of our master of science in computer science is to prepare and train the next generation of decision and data scientists. M.S. International-Track students will familiarize themselves with a broad range of theoretical and computational techniques from many areas of the mathematical and computational sciences. [...] Clermont Auvergne INP offers a Graduate Track program dedicated to smart and innovative mobility, structured around the following four master’s degrees :

 Master’s degree artificial perception & robotics
 Master of science in computer science
 Master’s degree in energy for sustainable engineering
 Master’s degree in innovative mechanisms and robots
